title: I think I made this game because I missed how games used to make me feel.I used to love playing games. But after I started working, that part of my life slowly faded away
author: Thin-While2427
selftext:
A few years later, I had this thought: Why don't I try making a game of my own?

I'm an app developer, so I thought I can figure it out.I was wrong. 😂

I had so many ideas, but I didn't know how games actually worked, where to find assets, or how to turn the things in my head into something playable.

I tried making different games. Some never worked out. Some I actually finished, but honestly, I didn't even enjoy playing them myself.

Eventually, I quit.But something kept pulling me back.

Then I remembered **Plants vs. Zombies**. That old feeling of playing a game that was simple to understand, fun to play, and full of personality.

I thought, what if I made something inspired by that kind of game, but with my own ideas, my own rules, and a story of my own?

6 months ago, I started exploring game development for the first time. After a lot of learning, failed attempts, and four months of building, I finally published my first game on Google Play.

It's called **Cat Warriors: Zombie War**.And the best part? I genuinely enjoyed making this one.

Now, sometimes I wonder whether there's still a place for games like this. So many games today offer huge worlds, intense combat, and complex mechanics. Mine is a simple 2D tower-defense game where cats fight to save a city and cure the dogs.

Maybe it's nostalgia. Maybe I just wanted to create the kind of game I personally enjoy playing.

But I still hope there are people out there who enjoy these kinds of games, too.I'm not expecting everyone to love it. I'd just really like to find the people who might.If games like Plants vs. Zombies were part of your childhood,  
I'd love to know: do you still enjoy this kind of game, or have your tastes changed over the years?

And if you're curious about what I made, here's the game:

🐱 [https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.catsvsdogs.game](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.catsvsdogs.game)
